Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 24  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that the limit was effectively ten games per year per developer due to the five-per-label cap and the practice of using subsidiary imprints. However, the correct interpretation of the licensing limit was five games per year per publisher, not per developer, and there was no official doubling of the limit to ten games per developer using two imprints. This misinterpretation of the policy led to an incorrect conclusion about the limit.
